text: It is truly heartwarming to witness the miraculous transformation of a simple cylinder of paraffin wax into a beacon of hope, provided one ignores the fact that it is essentially solidified petroleum byproduct slowly melting into a puddle of its own demise. This primary material, harvested from the depths of the earth and refined into a sticky, flammable substance, serves as the perfect metaphor for modern optimism: it burns brightly for a while, dripping hot tears onto the table, before inevitably vanishing into smoke, leaving behind only a wick that looks suspiciously like a burnt-out promise. Who needs logic or structural integrity when you can just rely on the sheer aesthetic appeal of a slow, self-consuming fire?
